title: Pathogen genomic surveillance status among lower resource settings in Asia
description: Journal article and assessment framework describing pathogen genomic surveillance capacity across 13 South and Southeast Asian countries, with findings on financing, quality assurance, workforce, supply chains, and data sharing.
keyFeatures: Assessment framework applied across 42 institutions in 13 countries.
Benchmarks pathogen genomics capacity in lower-resource Asian settings.
Identifies gaps in financing, quality assurance, workforce, supply chains, and data sharing.
Supports regional planning, investment cases, and capacity-building priorities.

Includes indicators on enabling environment, capacity, QA, strategic plan existence; shows variation between countries; identified priority pathogen types & low use of environmental or animal-human interface surveillance
practicalUse: Use this article to benchmark national or regional pathogen genomics capacity, identify priority system gaps, and support planning or funding proposals for genomic surveillance strengthening.
